title: Repair Linux project enumeration and Windows long-path controls
goal: Remove the remaining platform harness failures without changing detector semantics, capabilities, cases or timeout budgets.
acceptanceCriteria: The controls shadow clone succeeds for repository paths longer than the legacy Windows checkout limit.
The package-reference adapter enumerates only project files while retaining source-root, project-path and ancestor link checks.
The package-reference timeout remains 180 seconds and its claims, rules, policy and reviewed capabilities remain unchanged.
Fresh Windows and Linux matrices prove 191/191 equal semantics and controls prove 42 lock plus 180 capability cases.
Published 1.1.3 bytes, baselines, waivers and governance remain unchanged.
